data.content_ref: inline:Replace the per-node greedy DefenseWitness materialization with a canonical witness that stores, for each accepted node x, the complete set of accepted defenders that defeat each attacker of x, encoded as a bitset over the finite argument set. This set is uniquely determined by the grounded fixpoint and does not depend on enumeration order, so it avoids SRC_008's refutation. It is still a valid defense because every attacker is defeated by at least one member of the set; no minimality is claimed. Polynomial cost holds because each node's attacker-defender relation is already computed during fixpoint and bitset operations are linear in graph size. Criticism: full sets can be large, and the witness may include redundant defenders, but this is acceptable if the witness is not required to be minimal.
